categories.main_business_segments: Beijing YanDong Micro Electronic Co., Ltd. operates primarily in two segments: manufacturing and services, and products and solutions. The manufacturing and services segment focuses on power devices and ASIC wafer fabrication services, while the products and solutions segment provides discrete devices and analog integrated circuit solutions. The company serves sectors including consumer electronics, new energy, power electronics, and smart terminals.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs a Foundry+IDM hybrid model, integrating chip design, wafer manufacturing, packaging, and testing. It has advanced process technologies including 6-inch, 8-inch, and 12-inch wafer lines with platforms like 65nm and 28nm CMOS, BCD, SiC MOSFET, IGBT, and silicon photonics (SiN). Key proprietary technologies include trench MOSFET, TMBS, SiC SBD/MOSFET, and high-stability integrated circuits, supported by continuous R&D and innovation in semiconductor manufacturing and device design.
categories.primary_customers_markets: YanDong Micro serves primarily domestic customers in China across multiple industries such as consumer electronics, automotive electronics, new energy (e.g., photovoltaic and electric vehicles), AI, data centers, and telecommunications. Its products are used in applications like display drivers, power management, AI chips, and optical communication, targeting both industrial and consumer markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with headquarters and manufacturing facilities in Beijing and other Chinese regions. Its market coverage is predominantly domestic, with limited overseas sales. The company’s supply chain and customer base are largely concentrated in the Chinese semiconductor ecosystem.
categories.supply_chain_position: YanDong Micro operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the semiconductor supply chain. It provides wafer fabrication (foundry services), chip design, packaging, and testing, positioning itself as an IDM (Integrated Device Manufacturer) and foundry hybrid. It also offers discrete devices and integrated circuit solutions, serving as both a manufacturer and product supplier.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in semiconductor process technologies, including advanced CMOS nodes, silicon photonics, and third-generation semiconductors like SiC and GaN. It invests heavily in R&D (about 20% of revenue), focusing on high-voltage BCD, IGBT, SiC MOSFET, and silicon photonics platforms. Strategic priorities include expanding 12-inch wafer production capacity, enhancing product performance, and developing new applications in AI, automotive, and optical communications.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of discrete semiconductor devices and analog ICs, as well as wafer manufacturing and foundry services. The company also earns income from packaging and testing services. Revenue streams include direct sales to customers and long-term contracts, with some government subsidies and investment income contributing to other income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: YanDong Micro is a recognized domestic leader in power semiconductor devices and integrated circuit manufacturing in China. It competes with other Chinese semiconductor manufacturers and IDM/foundry companies. The company has been repeatedly recognized as a top ten power device enterprise in China and is advancing in silicon photonics and SiC technologies, positioning itself as a key player in the Chinese semiconductor industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.7 billion, a decline of about 20% year-over-year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 178 million. Total assets grew by over 30% to RMB 24 billion, driven by capacity expansion and acquisitions. R&D investment increased significantly to nearly 20% of revenue. The company is in a growth and capacity ramp-up phase, with ongoing large-scale projects in advanced wafer fabrication lines.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: YanDong Micro differentiates itself through integrated IDM and foundry capabilities, advanced proprietary process technologies, and a broad product portfolio including high-stability power devices and silicon photonics. Its value proposition centers on delivering high-quality, reliable semiconductor products with strong customization and technical support, enabling customers in emerging fields like AI, new energy, and optical communications to access domestically produced advanced chips with competitive performance.
